title: Senior Director - EMEA Solutions Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <p>The EMEA Field Engineering organization is the technical engine of CoreWeave’s regional go-to-market. It brings together account-aligned technical teams and deep specialists to help customers design, validate, deploy, and scale production workloads on CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform.</p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong>The Senior Director of Product & Engineering, EMEA reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA, with a matrix reporting line to the Global VP of Field Engineering and SVP of Product. As the senior field technology leader for the region, you will lead all EMEA field technical functions, with direct management accountability for account-aligned technical teams and matrix leadership of specialist teams. You will set the regional technical strategy, build a consistently high level of mastery across the specialisms required to serve AI infrastructure customers, and ensure teams are motivated, appropriately deployed, and equipped to succeed. Working across EMEA and global leadership, you will turn customer and business priorities into a disciplined technical operating model that accelerates adoption, expansion, and measurable value from CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform. You will be responsible for ensuring the product strategy of CoreWeave is assimilated across field teams in EMEA and - working with field enablement - ensuring that all teams maintain a high level of product competency. </p> <ul> <li>Set and execute the EMEA Field Product & Engineering strategy, operating model, and priorities in partnership with the VP and Managing Director of EMEA, Global VP of Field Engineering and SVP of Product.</li> <li>Act as the senior field technology voice for EMEA, shaping go-to-market priorities, customer engagement models, technical positioning, and regional investment decisions.</li> <li>Lead the account-aligned technical organization with direct accountability for organization design, performance, coaching, succession, hiring, retention, and leadership development across EMEA.</li> <li>Provide matrix leadership to specialist technical teams, aligning priorities, coverage, engagement standards, and accountability while partnering effectively with their global functional leaders.</li> <li>Build a measurable technical mastery system—including skills assessments, learning plans, communities of practice, playbooks, reference architectures, and proof frameworks—that keeps teams current across AI infrastructure, compute, Kubernetes, networking, storage, security, observability, and AI/ML workloads.</li> <li>Create repeatable engagement mechanisms that move customers from discovery and architecture through validation, onboarding, production readiness, adoption, optimization, and expansion on CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform.</li> <li>Serve as executive technical sponsor and escalation leader for strategic customers, advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders and mobilizing field, specialist, Product, Engineering, Support, and Operations resources around successful outcomes.</li> <li>Partner with EMEA sales leadership on account strategy, technical qualification, executive alignment, and resource allocation, sharing accountability for technical win rate, qualified pipeline, deal velocity, time to production, workload adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>Establish a rigorous regional operating cadence covering goals, metrics, forecasting, capacity and coverage planning, business reviews, and annual planning so performance and investment choices are visible and evidence based.</li> <li>Create a structured feedback loop from EMEA customers and field teams into Product and Engineering, translating recurring requirements, adoption blockers, competitive signals, and market dynamics into clear roadmap input.</li> <li>Represent CoreWeave’s technology vision through executive briefings, customer forums, conferences, and thought leadership, while bringing relevant market insight back into the business.</li> <li>Represent EMEA in global Field Engineering leadership, scale regional best practices across the company, and create an inclusive, high-performance environment in which teams are motivated and enabled to help customers adopt CoreWeave.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in technical design, implementation, consulting, pre-sales, solutions architecture, or another customer-facing technical discipline within cloud infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, enterprise software, or adjacent markets.</li> <li>10+ years of technical leadership experience, including 7+ years leading managers, senior individual contributors, or multi-country Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, or comparable customer-facing technical organizations.</li> <li>A record of leading distributed technical organizations through rapid growth, transformation, changing market conditions, and complex organizational dependencies.</li> <li>Strong technical credibility in cloud-native and distributed-systems architecture, with depth across several of the following domains: accelerated compute, Kubernetes, networking, storage, security, observability, data platforms, or AI/ML workload architecture.</li> <li>Demonstrated success guiding complex enterprise customers from strategy and solution design through validation, production deployment, operationalization, measurable adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>Experience advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders and translating complex architecture into business value, investment choices, delivery risk, and operating decisions.</li> <li>Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and connecting technical strategy to qualified pipeline, technical wins, deal progression, customer adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>A record of hiring, developing, and retaining technical leaders, together with building measurable enablement, accreditation, or continuous-learning programs that close capability gaps.</li> <li>Experience operating a metrics-based field organization, including goals, forecasting, capacity and coverage planning, resource prioritization, business reviews, and performance inspection.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to align Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, partners, specialist teams, and global leaders without relying solely on positional authority.</li> <li>Experience operating across EMEA markets, with the ability to travel regionally and internationally as required to support customers, teams, and company priorities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leadership experience in a high-growth AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, data-center infrastructure, enterprise platform, or developer-platform business.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing, large-scale AI training or inference, high-performance computing, and the operational requirements of distributed AI workloads.</li> <li>Experience navigating EMEA-specific customer requirements, including data sovereignty, security, regulation, procurement, and cross-border operating considerations.</li> <li>Experience establishing specialist communities of practice or centers of excellence, influencing product roadmaps, and representing a company through external technical thought leadership.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; postgraduate technical or business study is valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You love building technical leaders and teams that combine deep expertise, commercial awareness, and a relentless focus on customer outcomes.</li> <li>You’re curious about the fast-moving AI infrastructure landscape and turn new learning and customer insight into practical enablement and better products.</li> <li>You’re an expert at creating clarity, accountability, and momentum across direct and matrixed organizations operating at high speed and across cultures.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, i

title: Director, EMEA Field Marketing
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h2> <p>The <strong>Global Field Marketing Organization</strong> drives market penetration, customer engagement, and pipeline generation across key regions in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The team owns regional go-to-market strategy and execution — high-touch account-based marketing, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions — and works cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Events, Brand, and Demand to drive customer acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Director of EMEA Field Marketing</strong> to own the customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy and execution across EMEA, and to establish CoreWeave as a recognized and trusted brand in the region.</p> <p>This role will lead and grow a team of regional marketing managers, and partner closely with sales leadership to align marketing investments and resourcing around the GEO go-to-market strategy supporting customer acquisition and customer expansion across enterprise and AI-natives. As leader of Field Marketing for EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our regional marketing strategy across high-touch account-based marketing, 3rd party conferences, field programs, executive engagement, and partner-led motions.</p> <p>This role will own how CoreWeave shows up in the region — building awareness and credibility with European AI-native builders and enterprise buyers, and adapting the global brand narrative for a market with distinct data sovereignty, regulatory, language, and cultural requirements. Your leadership will drive the expansion of CoreWeave's presence and reputation in the dynamic and rapidly evolving EMEA AI-Cloud market.</p> <p>Success is measured by pipeline created and progressed, conversion rates across the funnel, deal velocity in priority accounts, and growth in regional brand awareness and consideration among target accounts.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <h3><strong>Regional Strategy & Pipeline Ownership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the EMEA customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy end to end, carrying accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline targets by segment, country, and priority account.</li> <li>Align marketing investment and team resourcing to the GEO go-to-market strategy, ensuring the regional plan reflects where Sales is prioritizing acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.</li> <li>Balance investment between near-term pipeline generation and the brand and category-building work required to make CoreWeave a known quantity in EMEA, and be able to articulate the tradeoff.</li> <li>Set the channel mix across ABM, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions based on ROI analysis and attribution data.</li> <li>Build distinct motions for acquisition and expansion: net-new account penetration and category presence on one side, deeper multi-workload engagement within existing customers on the other.</li> <li>Prioritize across a multi-country region — sequencing investment across core markets and emerging ones rather than spreading coverage thin.</li> <li>Manage a multi-million dollar regional budget with explicit ROI rationale, and defend allocation and resourcing decisions to marketing and sales leadership.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Brand Presence & Market Development in EMEA</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own CoreWeave's overall brand presence in EMEA — partnering with the Brand, Communications, and Product Marketing teams to build awareness, credibility, and consideration in a market where CoreWeave is still establishing itself.</li> <li>Adapt the global brand narrative for regional realities: data sovereignty and residency, EU regulatory context, local infrastructure footprint, language and cultural nuance — without fragmenting the global story.</li> <li>Land regional proof points — customer stories, local infrastructure milestones, partner wins — and make them visible in-market.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Sales Partnership & Account-Based Marketing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the senior marketing partner to EMEA sales leadership — in pipeline reviews, account planning, and forecast discussions — translating GEO priorities into funded, resourced programs.</li> <li>Direct high-touch ABM against CoreWeave's priority AI-native and enterprise accounts, partnering with Sales to define coverage, nomination criteria, and progression goals at the account and contact level.</li> <li>Drive disciplined lead and opportunity handoff with Sales and SDR, with agreed SLAs, shared quality definitions, and acceleration plays for stalled or late-stage deals.</li> <li>Build expansion programs alongside Sales and Customer teams that deepen engagement in existing accounts and surface new workloads, teams, and buying centers.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Market Presence & Executive Engagement</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Expand CoreWeave's presence across the EMEA AI-Cloud market, selecting the third-party conferences, field programs, and technical and developer-led moments where CoreWeave should show up — and holding each to a pipeline and brand thesis.</li> <li>Partner with the Executive Marketing team to connect regional CXO and VP engagement to opportunity progression in named accounts.</li> <li>Work with Partner Marketing to activate partner-led motions in-region — including the regional systems integrators, resellers, and cloud and ecosystem partners that carry disproportionate weight in EMEA — turning joint narratives into named-account plays and co-sell pipeline.</li> <li>Provide clear regional input into global campaigns and launches so they land effectively with EMEA audiences and buyer personas, and flag where regional adaptation is required.</li> <li>Partner with Developer Marketing to grow developer advocacy and engagement with in EMEA communities </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Data-Driven Optimization & Scalable Systems</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Manage the KPIs that matter — account and contact coverage, engagement, meetings, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion rates and stage progression — in Salesforce and the marketing automation and ABM stack.</li> <li>Establish testing and optimization frameworks across messaging, audience, channel, and offer: hypothesis, test, measure, then scale or retire.</li> <li>Build the repeatable systems that make regional growth predictable — program briefs and business cases, target account and contact selection, program templates, and playbooks any country team can run.</li> <li>Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations on attribution, lead scoring, and reporting so regional investment ties cleanly to revenue outcomes, and deliver post-program reporting that drives explicit go/no-go decisions.</li> <li>Work within EMEA data privacy and consent requirements (GDPR and local equivalents), partnering with Legal and Marketing Ops to keep regional data practices compliant.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Team Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a team of regional marketing managers, hiring to plan as the EMEA team scales.</li> <li>Build a team of pipeline-focused field marketers who understand the full customer journey, the sales process, and their own revenue impact.</li> <li>Set clear ownership boundaries and escalation paths so the team coordinates with Events, Brand, Partner Marketing, and Demand Gen rather than absorbing their scope.</li> <li>Represent EMEA performance and plans in global marketing forums, and partner with Americas and APAC counterparts on global initiatives.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experienced regional marketing leader:</strong> 10+ years in B2B marketing at high-growth technology or enterprise companies, with direct pipeline accountability across field marketing, demand generation, or ABM supporting EMEA.</li> <li><strong>People leader:</strong> 4+ years leading regional or field marketing teams with pipeline accountability, including hiring and developing marketers across a distributed, multi-country geography.</li> <li><strong>Brand builder in-region:</strong> Track record establishing or scaling a brand in EMEA for a company earlier in its regional journey — building awareness and credibility from a low base, and adapting a global narrative to local market realities.</li> <li><strong>EMEA market fluency:</strong> Deep understanding of the region's diversity — buying behavior, language and cultural differences, data sovereignty and regulatory considerations, and the partner and ecosystem landscape across core and emerging markets.</li> <li><strong>Sales-aligned operator:</strong> Proven experience partnering directly with executive sales leadership to shape GEO go-to-market plans, and allocating marketing investment and headcount against territory and account priorities.</li> <li><strong>Account- and deal-centric:</strong> Strong grasp of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise personas and how ABM, executive engagement, and field programs influence acquisition, expansion, and close rates.</li> <li><strong>Data and analytics depth:</strong> Advanced proficiency with pipeline attribution, conversion analysis, and ROI optimization using Salesforce, Tableau and ABM platforms, and BI tooling.</li> <li><strong>Program range:</strong> Demonstrated ability to build across the full regional mix — ABM, third-party conferences, field programs, executive experiences, brand and community moments, and partner co-marketing — with clear evidence of impact from each.</li> title: Head of Product Design
description: <div class="description content"> <p><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/">Thoughtworks</a> is a global technology consultancy that integrates design, engineering and AI to drive digital innovation. We are over 10,000 people strong across 47 offices in 18 countries. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology and culture as the differentiator.<br><br>Thoughtworks.com is one of our most important customer-facing products, helping clients discover our expertise, explore evidence of our impact and take the next step with us. It also helps job seekers explore opportunities and gives search engines and AI assistants an accurate, trusted understanding of who we are and what we do.</p> <p>Today, fragmented ownership across Marketing limits our ability to deliver connected customer journeys, maintain consistent quality and continuously improve performance.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Head of Product Design to change that. You’ll lead Thoughtworks.com as a digital product, translating our go-to-market and employer brand strategies into seamless experiences for customers, job seekers and AI agents. You’ll own the website strategy, roadmap, customer journeys, publishing model and content and design quality. You'll also shape experiences across connected channels, including email through Knak and events through Splash, while influencing the internal workflows that drive quality, consistency and speed.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who can think strategically and deliver at every level, from defining roadmaps and improving customer journeys to refining copy, reviewing designs, interpreting performance data and making launch decisions.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li> <h3>Website product strategy</h3> <ul> <li>Set the product vision, principles and roadmap for Thoughtworks.com</li> <li>Prioritize work around customer and business outcomes rather than requests for individual pages</li> <li>Connect the website roadmap to Thoughtworks’ go-to-market priorities, propositions and major company launches.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Customer journeys and experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build a deep understanding of our audiences, including enterprise buyers, technology leaders, practitioners, partners, prospective employees and alumni community</li> <li>Design connected journeys that help people move from a question/problem/need to relevant services, expertise, evidence and action, where the site fuels journeys on AI platforms that might never have users interact with our site</li> <li>Use customer research, website data and market insight to identify friction and opportunities</li> <li>Ensure the core website, event pages and email experiences work together where they form part of the same journey.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Narrative, copy and content quality</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the quality and coherence of the website narrative, copy and information architecture</li> <li>Translate complex technology services and Thoughtworks expertise into clear, credible experiences for different audiences</li> <li>Challenge unclear propositions, duplicated content, unsupported claims and pages that do not serve a defined customer need</li> <li>Work with the central Content team, service-line marketers and subject-matter experts, while keeping accountability for how content works within the overall experience</li> <li>Work with content operations to establish reusable content patterns, editorial standards and clear ownership for maintaining important content.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Experiences for people and agents</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ensure the website is useful and understandable to human visitors, search engines and AI assistants</li> <li>Partner with the SEO and LLM Discoverability Lead to improve how Thoughtworks is found, interpreted and represented to support buyers in their decision making process</li> <li>Shape requirements for structured content, metadata, evidence, content relationships and reusable information</li> <li>Balance machine readability with strong human storytelling, accessibility and brand expression.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Publishing model for the AI era</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the spec for redesigning the publishing workflow from brief through design, production, approval, release and ongoing improvement</li> <li>Work with the GTM tech and Global IT teams to replace manual, error-prone production with reusable patterns, clearer decision rights and proportionate automation</li> <li>Identify where AI can improve research, prototyping, content preparation, metadata, accessibility checks, quality assurance and content maintenance</li> <li>Turn good judgment into practical standards, templates, playbooks and automated checks</li> <li>Build a model that allows teams to move faster without lowering the quality bar or creating uncontrolled publishing.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Design quality and experimentation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set the direction and quality bar for UX, UI, interaction design and the website design system</li> <li>Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to improve journeys, messaging and conversion over time</li> <li>Sign off on experience quality before major launches.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Team and agency leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, experience production, transformation and discoverability</li> <li>Give people clear outcomes, decision rights, constructive feedback and room to do excellent work</li> <li>Build an effective working model with the central Content team, GTM technology, Global IT and service-line marketers.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>10 - 15 years experience leading digital products, customer experiences, service design or product design</li> <li>A strong record of turning customer insight and business strategy into coherent end-to-end experiences</li> <li>Excellent judgment across product, UX, content and design, with the ability to recognize and explain what good looks like</li> <li>Strong writing and editorial instincts, including the confidence to simplify complex ideas and challenge unclear copy</li> <li>Experience working with marketing, product, design, engineering and senior business stakeholders</li> <li>Commercial understanding and the ability to connect digital experience decisions to go-to-market outcomes</li> <li>Systems thinking, including experience creating reusable patterns, design systems, operating models or publishing frameworks</li> <li>Practical understanding of search, structured content and how AI assistants discover and interpret information</li> <li>Experience using AI tools to improve how work is researched, designed, produced or assured</li> <li>The ability to operate in ambiguity, make difficult prioritization decisions and move from strategy to delivery</li> <li>Evidence of leading and coaching people or multidisciplinary teams.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>You have a natural ability to establish and nurture relationships with senior leaders across the organization</li> <li>You have excellent context-switching capabilities</li> <li>You thrive in situations where you are given little to no direction and have the ability to lead, organize and deliver commitments on time and within budget</li> <li>You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives. You don’t shy away from risks, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them</li> <li>You’re empathetic and use this ability to build solid working relationships and resolve issues quickly and thoughtfully</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. description: Who we are At GetGround, our mission is to make property investment safer, faster and more accessible for everyone. We’ve built an all-in-one property investment platform that supports investors from opportunity analysis and company formation through to financing, accounting and portfolio management. By bringing software, data and specialist services into one experience, we make property investing simpler, clearer and more cost-effective. More than 30,000 investors across 70 countries trust us with their identity documents, company records, bank details and the financial picture of their portfolios. Several of our products are regulated by the FCA, and we’re now serving institutional clients and expanding into new markets. Our security needs to grow faster than we do. We’re looking for someone to own it. The opportunity You’ll be GetGround’s first dedicated security engineer. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll decide how we prevent, detect and respond to threats across our cloud, devices, identity and SaaS estate, and then build it. The scope goes beyond configuring tools. You’ll run our SIEM and own our alerts, keep us ahead of a threat landscape that AI is changing fast, and make sure leadership knows where we stand and what we need. You’ll work closely with our site reliability engineer, product engineers, our Compliance team and our Data Protection Officer. Over time, you’ll be able to shape how security works across GetGround, including the standards, processes and future hires we need. What you’ll do Own our security posture. You’ll be the person accountable for security at GetGround. Assess where we are today and define a roadmap that balances security with what the business needs. Be pragmatic: understand our stage, what risk we can accept for now and what has to be fixed today. Keep leadership informed about our risks, what you need and how we’ll address them. Stay ahead of threats. The threat landscape is moving faster than ever, and AI is driving much of that change. AI-generated phishing, deepfake social engineering, prompt injection and data leaking through AI tools are all part of it. Track what’s emerging, judge what matters to a regulated fintech and act before it reaches us. Run our SIEM and own our alerts. Make sure logs from GCP, identity, endpoints, SaaS tools and our own platform reach the SIEM and stay there. Write detection rules, map coverage against MITRE ATT&CK, tune out the noise and make sure nothing important goes unnoticed. Automate response. Build playbooks that contain common threats as soon as an alert fires. Lead incident response when things go wrong, and make sure we learn from it. Protect the data we hold. Know where sensitive data lives, who can access it and when it moves. Secure every channel it passes through: devices through endpoint detection and response (EDR) and anti-malware monitoring and protection, email and cloud storage through data loss prevention, and our platform and tools through access controls. Make the secure path the easy path for everyone at GetGround. Work across the business. Partner with our site reliability engineer and product engineers on secure infrastructure and design, and with Compliance on our obligations. Assess vendors and run training people actually remember. Set our policies and back them with working controls. Build and keep updating our security policies, best practices and information security management system (ISMS). Implement and automate the technical controls behind our security certifications and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, so that passing an audit reflects how we really operate. What you bring Hands-on detection and response experience. You’ve run a SIEM, built detection rules and owned alerting in production. You know what a bad log looks like. A habit of staying current. You follow how attackers are using AI and other new techniques. You turn what you learn into concrete defences, not headlines. Cloud security depth. You understand cloud infrastructure, identity and networking well enough to harden them, ideally on GCP. Endpoint and identity experience. You’ve run EDR, anti-malware and identity tooling across a company’s devices and SaaS estate. An automation-first mindset. You’d rather automate a control or a response than do it by hand, and you use AI tools to multiply your output. Judgement about risk. You can separate a real threat from a theoretical one, prioritise accordingly and explain the trade-off to people who aren’t specialists. Ownership and clear communication. You take responsibility for outcomes, surface problems early and tell leadership plainly what you need. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, an auditor or the CEO. Bonus Experience in fintech, financial services or another FCA-regulated environment. Experience implementing controls for security certifications such as ISO 27001. Experience with SOAR tooling and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform. Experience securing AI systems or LLM-based products. Experience as the first or only security hire at a startup or scale-up. Experience with UK GDPR or working alongside a Data Protection Officer. Experience with identity and zero-trust controls, such as SSO, phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access. Experience running penetration tests, red-team exercises or a bug bounty programme. This role isn’t for you if You want to stay in one specialism. In the same week you might write a detection rule, roll out a device policy and close a gap in our compliance controls. You’re comfortable with alerts nobody reads. We want fewer, better alerts, and someone who cares whether they lead to action. You see security as the department of no. We need someone who finds the secure way to ship, not someone who blocks the business by default. You want a fully defined programme to execute. We need someone who can assess what exists, set the direction and take ownership of it. You don’t connect with how we work. Our values—No BS, pursuit of excellence, feedback obsessed and healthy ego—mean communicating directly, holding a high bar, seeking feedback and being willing to change your mind. Why join Own security for a platform trusted with sensitive financial data by more than 30,000 investors. Build our security function from the ground up as we expand internationally. Work on challenging problems across cloud infrastructure, customer data, AI and regulated services. Competitive salary and meaningful equity. Hybrid London working, with three days per week in Waterloo. Benefits include private health and dental cover, a learning budget, a home-office setup budget and 12 mental health days per year. title: Lab Technician
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. We work with mid-market, enterprise and regulated organisations across cyber assurance, security architecture, governance and technology risk. We are appointing professionals who already hold formal UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) registration in Security Architecture at Principal or Chartered level, to join our associate panel and support the assessment and advisory of large, complex organisations. This is not permanent employment. Work is offered on a project-by-project basis according to client demand, suitability and availability. Please note: current UKCSC registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level is an essential requirement for this role. Applications without it will not be progressed. Tasks You may be asked to: Lead independent security architecture reviews and assurance for large, complex and regulated organisations. Assess cloud, hybrid and on-premises architectures across identity, networks, applications, platforms and data. Carry out threat modelling and identify credible attack paths, design weaknesses and control gaps. Judge whether proposed or alternative controls provide equivalent, proportionate protection. Review high-level and detailed designs and challenge unsupported assumptions. Advise boards, executives and technical teams on secure-by-design decisions and trade-offs. Produce clear, defensible, client-ready architecture findings and assurance reports. Complete scheme-specific training and participate in internal quality reviews where required. Requirements You must hold: Current UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) professional registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level. This is mandatory and will be verified. You should also have: Substantial experience as a practising security architect in large, complex or regulated organisations. Strong command of secure-by-design principles, threat modelling and architecture assurance. Practical experience across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, identity, networks, applications and data security. Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical decision-makers. SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP, CCSP and cloud certifications are welcome but do not replace the UKCSC registration requirement. You must be based in the UK, able to attend UK client sites when agreed, and able to contract through a limited company or another compliant arrangement. Benefits Senior, independent security architecture and assurance assignments. Flexible associate working based on your availability. Direct access to Intelance leadership. Work alongside experienced architects, governance and risk advisors and technical assessors. Clear scopes, templates and quality-review arrangements. Potential inclusion in Intelance proposals and associate credentials, subject to agreement. Please provide: Your CV and LinkedIn profile. Your UK Cyber Security Council registration: specialism, level (Principal or Chartered) and your registration number or public UKCSC profile link. Your location, availability and expected day rate. One example of a complex enterprise security architecture you personally designed or assured. Details of any relevant scheme, architecture or cyber-assurance qualifications. through qualified leads, opportunities created, pipeline progression and contribution to new-logo growth.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What you will being to Ensono</strong></p> <p> </p> title: Senior Data Science Manager
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our EMEA Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo and Wolt, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and deep business understanding. As part of DoorDash, our EMEA Data Science team brings together colleagues across Deliveroo and Wolt, creating opportunities to learn from different markets and tackle complex local-commerce challenges. We're looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You'll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact. About The Logistics Team Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers. These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics. It's an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team's work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy. What You'll Be Doing You'll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You'll: Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals. Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently. Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics. Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects. Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions. Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring: A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas. Experience setting analytical strategy and allocating people and effort across competing priorities, with clear evidence of product, operational or commercial impact. Strong technical foundations in experimentation, causal inference and statistical analysis, with the judgement to select appropriate methods, challenge conclusions and coach experienced practitioners. The ability to reason about interconnected systems and trade-offs, including how an intervention in one part of a marketplace can affect outcomes elsewhere. Experience influencing senior cross-functional leaders, aligning teams around shared goals and turning complex evidence into clear, actionable recommendations. A thoughtful approach to building teams: hiring, coaching, managing performance and developing future technical and people leaders. Comfort creating structure in ambiguous environments, making pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and adapting as new evidence emerges. Experience developing other people managers would be particularly valuable. Experience in marketplaces, logistics, mobility, pricing, incentives or other operationally complex businesses is helpful, but not essential. We also value leaders who can bring relevant approaches from other domains. You don't need to have worked on every problem listed here. We're interested in the depth of your leadership, the quality of your judgement and the impact you enable through others. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! title: QA Lead - Data Platform (TL1)
description: Location: Bristol or London Level: TL1 Team: Quality Contract: Permanent Reporting To: Shira Tsinovich Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities. About Kaluza Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future. Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life. With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen. What you’ll do As the QA Lead across Data you will work closely with the Data Org, setting the testing approach and quality standards for its products and platforms. You will be the quality partner for data delivery teams, advising on testing and quality assurance across the software delivery lifecycle. You will work with Data Engineering, Product teams, and clients to make sure changes meet the defined quality bar before they reach client environments. This is an individual contributor role with no line management responsibilities. You will influence through expertise, relationships, and evidence. Define and own the test strategy and test plans for the Data Org, deciding what is tested and how, based on risk, criticality, and impact to the business and clients. Create and deliver test plans for complex data systems, covering functional, transformation, schema, and ETL/migration testing, plus end-to-end coverage across data and engineering teams. Set the quality gates that determine whether a change is fit to be promoted to client environments, and assess release readiness against milestones. Ensure defects are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked to resolution in accordance with Quality standards, and drive root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact issues. Select and maintain the tools and frameworks used for testing, with automated checks running in CI/CD. Work with delivery teams, programme teams, and clients to support queries on test data and releases, and to maintain client confidence through clear, professional communication. Influence engineers, data analysts, and leadership to adopt a test-first mindset and own the quality of their products, and hold a firm line on quality standards. Report on test progress, quality trends, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and raise delivery risks and blockers early. Maintain documentation of quality standards, test coverage, and decisions, with transparency on known issues and risks. Act as the subject matter expert on data testing and data quality practices, including data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, timeliness). What you’ll bring Proven QA and testing experience: Strong knowledge of QA strategies, processes and methodologies, including defining and executing test plans, test cases and test scripts for complex software applications. Agile, test-first delivery: Experience in cross-functional Agile teams with a test-first mindset, managing priorities, scope and risk to maximise testing impact across distributed engineering organisations. Data testing and SQL: Working knowledge of data testing methods (data quality checks, schema validation, transformation testing, ETL/migration testing), plus SQL proficiency for querying and profiling large datasets to diagnose quality issues. Quality metrics and reporting: Experience building quality metrics, dashboards and reporting for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaboration and communication: Strong stakeholder management and verbal and written communication skills, working with development, product and client teams at all levels of management, including client engagement. Influence and coaching: Ability to influence and negotiate across engineering, product and leadership, hold a firm line on quality standards, and coach engineers and product managers to own the quality of their products. Client Delivery: experience working directly with client teams to define and report quality metrics, and to introduce quality improvement plans. Nice to have: Test automation framework experience; defining quality gates in CI/CD or release pipelines; AI tools for identifying and fixing data issues; data testing and observability tooling; familiarity with data governance, data contracts and GDPR; and Python and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker). Our Values Five values guide how we work at Kaluza: Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale. Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes. Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say. Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego. Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives. title: Founding Engineer (Product)
description: Founding Product Engineer London · £120K–£200K plus equity · Visa sponsorship available The Mission We are replacing the Management Consulting industry with software. The $1 trillion consulting industry is powered by some of the world’s brightest minds, yet they remain trapped in manual, inefficient workflows: spreadsheet orchestration, slide-deck assembly, and fragmented data synthesis. We proved it on ourselves first. Our advisory business serves six private equity funds across the UK, Europe and the US, and one Riplo consultant delivers an engagement that a tier-one firm staffs with a full team. The platform we built behind that work is now open to the world. Next, we are running the same playbook on a much bigger market: AI transformations for PE funds and the companies they own. Our team comes from QuantumBlack/McKinsey, BCG, DeepMind, Hg Capital and KKR. Cherry Ventures, Blue Lion and the founders of QuantumBlack back us, with angels from OpenAI, McKinsey, BCG and Apple. We are nine people, and we are hiring one Founding Product Engineer. The Challenge As our Founding Product Engineer, your role is not just “writing code”. You will report directly to our CTO, and define the product DNA of the company. You will: Build Beyond the Chatbot: Design multi-step agentic workflows that move past simple RAG and produce analysis a PE fund pays for. Make Quality Measurable: “Good enough for a partner” is a hard standard to code against. Build the evals, harnesses and review checks that prove an agent’s output meets it. Turn Evidence into Insight: Connect research, data and sources to the final page, so that every claim on a slide traces back to its evidence. Work Directly with Our Clients: Build AI use cases inside client organisations, alongside the people who use them. What you learn there shapes the core roadmap. Pioneer the Agentic SDLC: Agents write most of our code. Design the systems, steer the agents, and push our own way of building software forward with a very large token budget. You Are a Fit If: You are a Product Builder: You might be a product engineer at a SaaS company, a product manager who now ships code, or a consultant building serious AI tooling on the side. We judge purely on the quality of what you have built. You don’t need a 20-page PRD. You can take a vague user pain point from a client and ship a functional prototype by Friday. You value Speed: You believe that in an early-stage startup, iteration velocity is the only unfair advantage. You prefer shipping a 90% solution today over a perfect one next month. You are “T-Shaped”: You hold deep experience in one area (product management, management consulting, or front-end engineering), but are comfortable enough with the others to add value across the business. Our Stack Product: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Tailwind Data and Infra: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Terraform Real-time: Collaboration over WebSockets Why Join Us? Real Ownership: £120K to £200K base salary plus equity. You will own a piece of the company you are building, and you will own the product roadmap with the CTO. High Trust / Low Bureaucracy: We value clarity of thought and bias to action. No middle management, no pointless meetings, just building. The Practicalities: London-based, four days a week in the office, one flexible day, and client site time when projects require it. Visa sponsorship available. title: AI Transformation Director
description: About Riplo Riplo is a VC-backed, AI-native advisory and technology firm serving private equity across the deal lifecycle. We combine deep diligence expertise, forward-deployed AI teams and our own AI platform to give PE funds and their portfolio companies sharper answers and working AI, faster. We are growing quickly, winning work with leading funds and expanding the team, and this hire is a key part of that next phase. Advisory: thematic research, commercial due diligence (CDD), AI due diligence, AI value creation, AI build solutions and exit readiness. Solutions: forward-deployed AI teams that turn AI value creation plans into working software and measured value inside portfolio companies. Software: building the operating layer for consulting. Clients: mid-market and large-cap PE funds and their portfolio companies across the UK, Europe and the US. Operating model: flat and AI-leveraged. Senior people work directly on the programme, supported by AI rather than layers of juniors. Team: a blend of DD consultants, PE portfolio operators, AI advisors and AI engineers, with advisory and engineering working side by side. Our team and culture AI is rewriting the rules of consulting and of how portfolio companies operate. Most advisory firms are waiting to see what happens. We decided to be the ones making it happen. We are a small, senior team that moves fast, sets a high bar and genuinely enjoys building Riplo together. Every person here shapes what Riplo becomes. We build side by side in the office 4–5 days a week, because the best ideas come from being in the room together. If you want to sit at the table with us, roll up your sleeves and build something that matters, we want to meet you. AI Transformation Director, Solutions · London (in office 4–5 days a week) · Full-time This is not a typical transformation role. You will be a key hire working side by side with our Founding Head of Solutions, leading embedded AI transformation programmes inside PE-backed portfolio companies, standing up and running their AI Transformation Office, and helping build Riplo's Solutions practice from the ground up. You will own the programme from week 1: governance, roadmap, use-case selection and the path from first build to measured value. Most programmes start with a list of 100+ ideas; your job is to turn that into 5 to 6 quantified use cases with named owners, get the first live within 6 weeks, evidence value against a baseline, and hand over a running office to a permanent owner. You will have the autonomy of a founder, the exposure of a partner, and the tools of an AI-native firm. Your work will show up directly in portfolio company P&Ls, in fund value creation plans, in our product and in how Riplo grows. What you'll do Lead AI transformation programmes Stand up the client's AI Transformation Office: decision rights, delivery process, monthly AI SteerCo and executive sponsorship. Build and own the AI roadmap for the next 6+ months, sequenced with the client's data and platform foundations. Run the use-case staircase end to end: select by week 3 on value, readiness and sponsorship; specify the redesigned workflow by week 4; get working tools in front of real users by week 6; measure results against baseline. Sequence builds so each one reuses the capability the last one created, making every later use case faster and cheaper. Gate every build on a named business owner, a baseline, a funded run cost and a route into daily use, with monthly cost and value reporting to the SteerCo. Drive adoption and capability Own adoption, not just delivery: enablement strategy, training, stakeholder engagement and usage dashboards that move AI from experimentation to daily workflow. Compress how client teams build software, embedding agentic practices from spec to release and coaching engineers through the change. Build the client's own capability, with a plan to move at least half of AI engineering capacity in-house within 6 months. Write the operating model, governance and roadmap for the permanent owner, overlap their first month and hand over a running office. Lead forward-deployed teams Lead embedded teams of AI architects, forward-deployed engineers and PE operators, keeping strategy and production code in one team. Translate business problems into tractable AI solutions, bridging executives, domain experts and engineers. Present progress and evidenced value to portfolio company leadership, operating partners and deal teams. Build the practice Scope and write proposals and RFP responses, and support pitches to new and existing funds. Turn each programme into reusable playbooks, assets and platform features that make the next transformation faster than the last. Produce thought leadership on AI value creation (sector notes, case studies, LinkedIn content). Build relationships with operating partners, portfolio company executives and technology partners. What you'll bring 3+ years across strategy consulting, PE value creation and enterprise AI or software delivery, including time at a top-tier consultancy, an enterprise AI vendor or in a PE-backed operating role. A track record of leading AI or digital transformation at enterprise or portfolio company scale, from strategy through to adopted, production systems. Measurable outcomes you can point to: adoption moved from near zero to the majority of a workforce, products shipped, or value evidenced against a baseline. C-suite and investor credibility: you have aligned CEOs, CFOs, operating partners and technology leaders around priorities, funding and trade-offs. Hands-on technical depth: you understand LLMs, agentic tooling, data platforms and the software development lifecycle well enough to lead architects and engineers, and you have built with them yourself. Commercial judgment: you tie every AI initiative to productivity, revenue or enterprise value, and you have owned presales, proposals or a P&L. Proven leadership of cross-functional teams of data scientists, engineers and solution architects under tight timelines. AI fluency: you already use AI tools daily and can show how they make your work faster and better. Who you are Founder mindset: this is your business to own and grow. You treat Riplo's success as your own. Outcome-obsessed: you measure success in adoption and evidenced value, not decks delivered or tools launched. Proactive: you see what needs doing and do it before being asked. Builder: you would rather ship a working tool in week 6 than perfect a strategy in week 12. Ownership mindset: you take initiatives from idea to delivery and own outcomes, not just tasks. AI-first: you look for the AI-enabled way to do every step, and keep refining it. Calm under pressure: you lead with clarity when timelines are tight, stakeholders disagree and the path is ambiguous. Comfortable with ambiguity: you thrive in a small, fast-moving team without rigid structure. Why Riplo Build something from the ground up: join early and help define what AI-native transformation looks like for private equity. Real impact, fast: your programmes move portfolio company P&Ls and feed directly into fund value creation plans. Senior from day one: lead client SteerCos, shape proposals and own executive and fund relationships. Work at the frontier: lead our own AI engineers and platform inside client businesses, not just talk about AI. Grow with the firm: a clear path to take on more as Riplo's Solutions practice scales. Competitive package: salary, bonus and equity (details discussed at interview). Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Designer
description: In just over two years, we’ve gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world’s carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners. We’re now looking for a stellar Product Designer who’s buzzing to create exceptional experiences for installers as we expand into new markets. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK’s carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there’s simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can’t currently offer a heat pump when someone’s boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We’re fixing this. We’ve built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we’re having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates. We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We’re in the process of expanding outside heat pumps and by the end of the year will be an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and autoCAD, you might get a sense of where we’re headed… 🥖 The Role You’ll be central to our mission as we turn historically slow and painful processes into ones that are quick, intuitive and even delightful for installers. We’ve been design-led since the beginning but the challenge is only growing as our product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you’ll be: Making complex decisions feel effortless – Our platform handles everything from building physics calculations to fluid dynamics modelling to complicated compliance requirements. We need to make handling that complexity feel effortless for all our customers, irrespective of how tech-savvy they are. Designing across multiple touchpoints – You'll work on desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work seamlessly across different user types (from 3-person local installers to national utilities); Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs can be shipped quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team); Building systematic, scalable design systems – Creating robust, structured, and reusable components that work across platforms and for potentially low-tech users; Researching and validating - Interviewing and spending time with installers to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems to solve are; and building quick prototypes to test and validate design decisions and uncover unexpected pain points. You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO. 🫵 About You We’re looking for a designer with 3+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially a lot more), ideally in a startup context or within fast-paced, impact-focussed teams. We'd love to speak with you if you are: A clear, systematic thinker who loves tackling complex flows; Comfortable with diving into technical detail, even if it’s a new domain; User-obsessed; you enjoy deeply understanding the user, solving their problems and making a tangible impact on them; Great with people and confident running research with customers; Proactive and self-organising, happy juggling multiple projects; Bonus if you’ve worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or on operational workflows (but absolutely not a requirement!). 🌟 Our offer 💰 £70-100k salary, depending on experience. 🍰 Meaningful slice of equity (options) in the company 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year 🏡 Hybrid working: 2–3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight 🏥 Private Medical Cover 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme ( YellowNest ) 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow 🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce We’re currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight. You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense. We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. This is clearly particularly important for this role but you’ll be surrounded by a whole team who are also close to our customers. We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back. Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back. title: Senior Commercial Product Manager
description: About us Every large industrial company is trying to make better decisions with the data it already owns. Most hit the same wall. Strategy lives in one system, sales in another, the market model in a consultant's spreadsheet, and the plan in a deck nobody has opened since the offsite. By the time a regional head knows a segment has moved, the quarter is gone. The data exists. It just never arrives anywhere a decision is being made. STRATOS was built to solve this problem. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup funded extensively by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by nearly a dozen global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI. The role. As a Senior Commercial Product Manager, you own a portfolio of our most important customers. You are responsible for the success of each deployment, for the value it creates for the customer, and for growing the relationship from initial pilot to organisation-wide rollout. You work directly with their C-suite and sales leadership to understand their business model, their commercial priorities, and where untapped growth potential lies across their markets, segments and accounts. You translate those priorities into what STRATOS delivers. You define what the solution needs to do, work with our engineers to make sure it gets built right, and bring the results back to the customer's decision-makers. You bridge two worlds: the customer's commercial reality and our product. Your responsibility doesn't end at go-live. You stay at the customer's side as they put the solution to work: challenging their thinking, helping them act on what the data shows, and making sure the impact is visible in their results. This role suits someone who wants to own outcomes rather than just recommend them. Beyond your own accounts, you help shape the direction of STRATOS – what we build, how we deploy it and how we grow. The roles you'll play Trusted advisor to the C-suite — work directly with executive teams and sales leadership on where to play, how to win, and how to organise and steer a sales force. You are the person they call before they decide, not after. Owner of the customer, end to end — from first pilot to multi-country rollout, the deployment, the relationship and the results are yours. Our engineers build it; you decide what gets built and you stand behind whether it worked. Commercial owner of your portfolio — you are responsible for its growth: expansion into new use cases and new markets, and the judgement of when a customer is ready for more and when they are not. Product manager for your market — you translate what you see across your customers into our roadmap, define what gets built, and own it with engineering through to release. Builder of the function — you shape how STRATOS deploys and scales: the standards, the tooling and the people. Senior CPMs coach the CPMs around them. Who this is for. We hire for commercial judgement and the credibility to hold a room of executives. That does not come from one background, and we are open about where yours comes from. What we're actually looking for: You have owned a complex piece of work end to end — scoping it, aligning stakeholders who disagreed, delivering it, and being accountable for whether it worked. We're interested in people who ran the engagement, not only staffed it. You can hold your own with a commercial director who has run their business for twenty years and change their mind with evidence rather than seniority. You do your own analysis. You are comfortable in the data, and you'd rather check the number yourself than take it from a slide. You can explain something complicated to someone non-technical without making them feel stupid. You are genuinely interested in how industrial businesses make money — pricing, channels, sales coverage, market structure. You want to be somewhere your decisions are visible. At our size, the roadmap changes because of what you bring back. This is probably not for you if you want a defined remit, a stable set of processes, or a role where strategy and delivery are separate jobs. Craft that's respected, not traded off. Strict typing, layered testing, ADRs, observability — and AI-native ways of working as the baseline, not an experiment. <li>Balanced Teams</li> <li>Utilisation governance</li> <li>RM reporting and dashboards</li> <li>Process standardisation</li> <li>Skills and capability visibility</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></p> <p>The successful candidate will ideally have:</p> <ul> <li>Experience in Resource Management, People Operations, or a related area is desirable.</li> <li>This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is motivated to make an impact, not simply tick boxes; it requires initiative, ownership and an appetite for challenge.</li> <li>Strong communication, proactive, problem-solving skills with a practical, solutions-focused approach.</li> <li>Ability to operate independently while recognising when issues require senior escalation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What
