title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description: <p><strong>Forward Deployed AI Engineer</strong></p> <p><em>DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.</em></p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Global AI Strategy & Solutions defines how DEPT®’s clients respond as AI agents become the primary layer between customers and brands. The Future of the Customer Journey (FCJ) is the team’s flagship offer: it maps how AI systems intermediate customer journeys, diagnoses where a brand’s product reality diverges from what AI systems say about it, and directs investment accordingly. Growth and strategy teams across markets are selling and delivering it now.</p> <p>As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you are an embedded builder inside that motion. You will sit with growth and strategy teams, understand the problem in front of them, and answer with working software rather than documentation. You will convert FCJ methodology into agentic components, prototypes, and internal tools, and integrate with infrastructure that lets new prototypes appear in days. When needed, you will work across global client projects on a partially billable basis, making sure the firm-wide strategy is captured and implemented properly rather than reinvented market by market. As components mature, you will collaborate with product and craft teams to keep everything compatible with the long-term platform and hand over cleanly. </p> <p>You will be given broad problem statements to help collaborate and solve, not specific product ideas and features to create. We are not looking for someone to lead on devops or CI/CD, this is about having great ideas that are sensitive to our clients’ real challenges, and shipping prototypes and strategic tools rapidly. </p> <p>Your most important collaboration is with the FCJ core team on the global growth strategy: deciding what gets built next, for which market, to unlock which engagement. The toolchain will keep changing underneath you, new models, new vendor products, new technology-partner platforms, and that is the point. This role suits an engineer who learns by shipping and treats every new AI product as something to master in the field.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the FCJ core team on the global growth strategy, converting methodology into working agentic components, prototypes, and internal tools.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with growth and strategy teams to understand their problems and provide working solutions at prototype pace.</li> <li>Work across global client projects on a partially billable basis, ensuring the firm-wide FCJ strategy is captured and implemented consistently across markets.</li> <li>Collaborate with product and craft teams where necessary to document integration paths, maintain platform compatibility, and hand over validated components.</li> <li>Work with technology partners to evaluate, adopt, and integrate new AI products; maintain an AI-native toolchain and share what works across markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience prototyping and shipping software in any modern backend language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar), with the ability to leverage AI tooling to spin up prototype frontends and APIs quickly.</li> <li>Experience building applications across the mainstream LLM model families (Gemini, GPT, Claude), connecting models to enterprise data and tools using patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and skills-based agent systems.</li> <li>Proficiency in working with APIs to connect different services, authentication, data exchange, and integration across platforms.</li> <li>Experience developing agentic systems with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent.</li> <li>AI-native way of working: AI tooling is the default across coding, research, and delivery, with comfort spanning the tools in use across different markets.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a forward-deployed, customer engineering, solutions engineering, or applied AI role within an agency, consultancy, or AI company.</li> <li>Experience presenting working software to non-technical stakeholders, including strategists and clients, and iterating live on their feedback.</li> <li>Knowledge of emerging integration standards such as OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting agents to business systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of any of the following: paid media, social platforms, user behaviour, agentic commerce, or generative engine optimisation (GEO).</li> <li>Experience with evaluation, tracing, and observability for LLM applications.</li> <li>Demonstrated learning mindset: a record of adopting new AI products from technology partners quickly, learning by doing rather than waiting for training.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We Offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>A flexible, hybrid working policy (2 days from the office in London).</li> <li>An excellent salary based on experience and equal pay policies</li> <li>Pension, free private healthcare, mental health support, and company sick pay scheme.</li> <li>26 days paid holiday (plus UK Bank Holidays).</li> <li>Help getting you to work with a season ticket loan and cycle to work scheme.</li> <li>Enhanced family friendly policies to support new parents.</li> <li>Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.</li> <li>Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and events.</li> <li>Learning and Development, supporting your growth with continuous opportunities to learn and advance.</li> <li>Buddy Programme: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®.</li> <li>A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/en-gb/insight/dept-is-a-certified-b-corporation/">B Corp® since 2021</a> and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.</li> <li>Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!</li> <li>The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.</li> <li>Global annual <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/dept-cares-day-2023/">DEPT® Cares Month</a> in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why DEPT®?</strong></p> <p>We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.</p> <p>At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build..</p> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity & Inclusion </strong></p> <p>At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. title: Security & Privacy Lead
description: We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health. Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar. Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale. About the role As Scarlet's first Security & Privacy Lead, you will own how we protect the information our customers trust us with. They share highly sensitive data with us, and keeping it safe is one of our most important responsibilities. Scarlet is growing fast, and our security and privacy programme has to keep up the pace. You will own our ISO 27001-certified information security management system and our data privacy programme, and make them scale as we grow. You will work closely with engineering to find and fix risks early, and with teammates across Scarlet so that everyone, from new joiners to contractors, has a secure environment that works for them. You will also shape how Scarlet adopts AI tools safely, assessing the threat vectors of new tools and helping build an internal ecosystem of AI tools that is secure by design. Responsibilities Own and improve Scarlet's ISO 27001-certified ISMS. Own and improve Scarlet's GDPR-compliant data privacy programme. Be hands-on with implementing and maintaining controls. Perform information security and data privacy risk assessments for vendors and AI tools. Help build Scarlet's internal ecosystem of AI tools, so that it is secure by design and lets colleagues use AI freely and safely. Lead threat modelling with our engineers, commission external penetration tests and drive their findings to resolution. Represent Scarlet's security and privacy to customers. Proactively monitor our systems and operations to spot real vulnerabilities with practical consequences. Required qualifications Experience owning an ISMS through ISO 27001 certification or surveillance audits. Experience running a GDPR compliance programme. Experience assessing the information security and data privacy risks of third-party services. Experience working with engineers on threat models and penetration test remediation, with the technical judgement to read an architecture and challenge it. Experience explaining technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues and customers. Preferred qualifications Experience working in a highly regulated environment, such as medical devices or conformity assessment. Experience with SOC 2 or other security attestations. Experience automating compliance work. title: Property & Facilities Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>12-month fixed-term contract | Caregiver leave cover. Deadline for applications is November 20th.</strong></p> <p>📍 London | 💰 Salary £60,000 - £65,000 + Incentive Awards - <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> |<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4"> Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <h2><strong>⭐ Our People team</strong></h2> <p>We call it Monzo Magic. Mission. Action. Growth. Inclusion. Care.</p> <p>It's at the heart of everything we do. Within our People Collective, we're here to bring brilliant people together, build an inclusive culture and create an environment where everyone can do their best work. As Monzo continues to grow, our offices play an important role in bringing our people together. They're more than just places to work. They're spaces where teams connect, collaborate and experience what it means to be a Monzonaut.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced <strong>Property & Facilities Lead</strong> to join us on a 12 month fixed term contract, covering caregiver leave. You'll lead a team of six across four office locations in London, Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona, helping us deliver an exceptional workplace experience while managing and developing our global property portfolio.</p> <p>Reporting to the Head of Property, Culture and Engagement, you'll oversee our daily operations, lead strategic projects and collaborate with teams across Monzo to create safe, welcoming and engaging workplaces that bring people together and put the Monzonaut community first.</p> <h2><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by...</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>🏢 Leading our global property and facilities operations</strong> – Overseeing our office locations, ensuring they're safe and compliant, while delivering a consistent and delightful workplace experience.</li> <li><strong>🚀 Managing and delivering property projects</strong> – Leading projects from planning to delivery, including office moves, refurbishments and new site launches. You'll manage timelines, budgets and internal and external stakeholders to deliver successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>🌍 Supporting our global property strategy</strong> – Turning our longer term property ambitions into practical plans, ensuring our spaces meet the needs of our people and support Monzo's continued growth.</li> <li><strong>💪 Leading and developing a brilliant team</strong> – Managing six team members across all locations, setting clear priorities, supporting their development and building a scalable, high-performing function.</li> <li><strong>🤝 Collaborating across Monzo</strong> – Building strong relationships with Finance, Legal, TechOps and senior leadership to align priorities, influence decisions and deliver improvements.</li> <li><strong>💰 Managing budgets and suppliers</strong> – Overseeing property and facilities budgets, managing supplier relationships and ensuring we're delivering value for money across our portfolio.</li> <li><strong>🦺 Keeping our spaces safe and sustainable</strong> – Ensuring our workplaces meet health and safety requirements, managing compliance and working with the ESG team to deliver our Scope 1 and 2 environmental commitments.</li> <li><strong>✨ Continuously improving how we work</strong> – Using data and employee feedback to improve our spaces, streamline processes and build scalable ways of working. You'll also be happy to roll up your sleeves and provide hands on support when needed.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>🤩 We'd love to hear from you if...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have strong <strong>property and facilities management experience</strong>, ideally in a fast-paced, growing organisation with multiple office locations.</li> <li>You're an <strong>experienced project manager</strong>, confident leading complex projects end to end, managing timelines, budgets, risks and competing priorities.</li> <li>You're a <strong>confident people leader</strong>, with experience managing, coaching and developing high performing teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>commercially minded</strong>, with experience managing budgets, suppliers and contracts while balancing cost, quality and employee experience.</li> <li>You're a <strong>strong communicator and collaborator</strong>, comfortable working with senior stakeholders and building relationships across teams.</li> <li>You're <strong>proactive, organised and adaptable</strong>, able to balance day-to-day operations with strategic priorities, navigate ambiguity and make decisions independently.</li> <li>You're <strong>data-driven</strong>, and can use insights to make decisions and improve processes.</li> <li>You have a good understanding of <strong>workplace health and safety</strong>, and are confident using digital tools such as Google Workspace and Slack</li> <li>[Nice to have] You have a formal health and safety, facilities and/or project  management qualification such as IWFM 7, NVQ, NEBOSH, PRINCE 2 or APM.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! </strong>We know that some people are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every requirement. At Monzo, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we care just as much about your potential as your experience. If you're excited about this opportunity and think you could make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.</p> <h2><strong>🙌 What's in it for you</strong></h2> <p>💰 £60k - £65k + Incentive Awards</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days per week in the office. You'll also travel periodically to our Cardiff, Dublin and Barcelona offices.</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to manage your time in a way that works for you, your team and the role.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 annual learning budget to spend on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We'll provide you with a MacBook and the equipment you need to work effectively.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <h2><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h2> <p>Our hiring process is designed to help us get to know you, your experience and how you approach real-world challenges.</p> <p>There are four stages:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Initial call</strong> – An initial conversation to learn more about you and share more about the opportunity.</li> <li><strong>Role-specific interview</strong> – A deeper conversation about your technical experience, project management and approach to leading a multi-site function.</li> <li><strong>Manager and leadership interview</strong> – An opportunity to explore your leadership style, stakeholder management and how you approach decision-making.</li> </ol> <p>We aim to complete the process in around 2–3 weeks and will be as flexible as possible to accommodate your schedule.</p> <p>We also have some guidance on using AI during your application and interview.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read it here.</a></p> <p>#LI-OH #LI-LONDON</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍 London (UK)  | 💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers#benefits"> Benefits</a></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting Team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Capital, Impairments & Forecasting team (CIF) sits at the intersection of our Borrowing and Finance collectives, responsible for developing, executing and managing the models used to calculate IFRS 9 ECL, and credit risk capital through the annual ICAAP. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. You’ll craft an ambitious roadmap rooted in deep customer insight, emerging market dynamics, and commercial impact—setting a vision that differentiates Monzo in the business banking space.</p> <p>This role is a rare blend of strategic thinking, world-class product taste, analytical depth, and an ability to consistently ship great work. our business customers.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Product Strategy & Vision</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set a bold, customer-centric, commercially grounded product strategy for offerings.</li> <li>Drive teams to create unique, delightful products based on exceptional product taste.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Analytical & Strategic Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spar with data scientists and use data to understand “the why” behind customer behaviour, product performance, and opportunities.</li> <li>Help teams deepen their analytical thinking, improving decision-making quality across the org.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & High-Performance Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build an execution engine that consistently delivers against ambitious goals.</li> <li>Create extreme clarity on priorities, establish strong processes, remove blockers, and maintain team momentum.</li> <li>Instil a culture of ownership, speed, and high performance.</li> </ul> teams to thrive.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and develop exceptional product managers, helping them reach their full potential and cultivating the next generation of Monzo product leaders.</li> </ul> As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll be your partner and guide throughout the interview process.</li> <li><strong>Initial Call (45 mins)</strong> You'll meet with one of our engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You’ll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team throughout the process. If you’d like to ask a question sooner, email <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a></p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary range for this role is dependent on experience + equity + stock options & benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here</strong></a></p> <p>#LI-SS2</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. title: Linux Desktop Support Engineer (London UK office)
description: <p>This is an opportunity to kickstart your career by joining Canonical. You will be working from our Canonical London Office and will be accountable for delivering technical support to our employees and customers, as well as facilitating AV support for office conferences and events. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>True Ownership:</strong> Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.</li> <li><strong>Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance:</strong> Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Advocacy:</strong> Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.</li> <li><strong>Operational Reliability:</strong> Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What are we looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Communication Excellence:</strong> Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.</li> <li><strong>The Soft-Skill Edge:</strong> A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.</li> <li><strong>Academic Dedication:</strong> Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li><strong>Educational Background:</strong> An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li><strong>On-Site Technical Leadership:</strong> Based in our state-of-the-art London, UK office, you will serve as a key technical support resource for our local teams and employees.</li> <li><strong>Driven Mindset:</strong> A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li><em>Virtualization & Cloud:</em> Using KVM or OpenStack.</li> <li><em>Containers:</em> primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.</li> <li><em>Storage Ecosystems:</em> Block, object, and network storage technologies.</li> <li><em>System Networking:</em> Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Analytical Curiosity:</strong> A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off - title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business. You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders. The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance. You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA. - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development. - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover. - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion. - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows. - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization. - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership. - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities. - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions. - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery. - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions. - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems. - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans. - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments. - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders. - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs. NICE TO HAVES - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment. - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows. - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration. - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling. - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs. - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts. - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up. - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system - title: Product Marketing Manager
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Linear’s products are brought to market and understood by customers. This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design, CX, Sales, and Marketing, and is responsible for turning technically sophisticated product work into clear narratives, strong launches, and high-quality customer-facing experiences. You’ll go deep on the product, define positioning and messaging, and drive execution across the surfaces that matter most—from in-product copy and changelogs to enablement, documentation inputs, email, and launch communications. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines product judgment, excellent writing, and strong cross-functional leadership. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America and the United Kingdom. You can work from anywhere within these regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. What you’ll do - Develop positioning, messaging, and core narratives for feature releases, key launches, and strategic product narratives - Partner closely with Product management, Engineering, and Design to refine how products are presented across in-product and external surfaces - Create and coordinate launch deliverables such as changelogs, demos, enablement materials, email, social copy, and go-to-market communications - Equip Sales, CX, and other customer-facing teams with the context and materials they need to communicate new launches effectively - Bring customer insight, product understanding, and market context back into product and launch decisions What we’re looking for - Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, with the ability to make complex ideas feel clear and compelling - Strong positioning and messaging skills grounded in customer problems, product truth, and differentiation - Great project management skills and ability to track large amounts of detail. - Comfort going deep on product details and building credibility with Product, Engineering, and Design - Strong judgment, ownership, and the ability to operate autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar What we offer We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect: - Competitive salary and equity - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday - Paid co-working space or desk - Health coverage (based on country requirements) - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays - 4 months paid parental leave - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter - Regular team events and off-sites - Remote-first with no required commute Compensation For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $145,000—$192,500. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.
